results.explanation:
Numbers checked against the tool results: OTR 34.7 vs 15.9, cancel ratio 0.98, max_resting 0.1347, distance 0.077, depth 2458, symmetry 0.9907, 8606/8606, 253 before the opposite trade, 96, round trip 3.58, typical size 327 vs 331, and price bands 9991-9993 and 9995-9997 all appear in the tool output. No invented figures. The 'every 1-5 s' re-quote cadence is slightly loose, since gaps of 6-7 s exist.

The disposition follows from the evidence. The procedures' market-making test is met: two-sided quotes, symmetry near 1, desk-typical size, cancels following re-quotes. Feature (b) is absent: no price move, no reversion, and the fill was on its own quote. Bid fills of 253 came before the 96-lot opposite trade, exceeding it. Large_orders is empty, so the one-sided escalation test does not apply. Memory is used as context only.

Weaknesses:
(1) The sequence is only partly explicit. The 96-lot sell at 15:52:06.887 and the joint cancel at 15:52:08 are given. The bid partial fills (148 at 15:51:21.692, 105 at 15:51:45.537) are not timed, so a reviewer must reconstruct them.
(2) Indicator wording is loose. 'Opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as not matched, yet such a fill did occur; only the benefit was absent.
(3) Algorithmic re-pricing is marked 'undetermined' while citing E2 under ruled_out_by, which is internally muddled.
(4) The 3.58-tick round trip is labelled spread income without noting it exceeds 'a tick or two'.

These are mostly presentation gaps rather than reasoning failures. The core logic is sound, grounded and actionable, though more than one point is soft.
results.label: Good
